svg.title: Urolithin A (Mitopure): what has actually been tested
svg.desc: Urolithin A (Mitopure): what has actually been tested. Regulatory status (US): FDA had “no questions” on the maker’s GRAS notice for foods (2018); not a drug. Verdict: Food ingredient. Lifespan in animals: Longer life in worms (2016, 2025) and in one mouse study (2023); exercise gains in rodents. Verdict: Early animal signals. Lifespan in people: No human trial has tested whether it extends life. Verdict: Not tested. Muscle and walking in older adults: Main goals missed in two 4-month trials; endurance and strength signals. Verdict: Mixed. Pooled evidence: 2026 meta-analysis: walking gain not significant; low certainty. Verdict: Inconclusive. Heart, vessels, brain: Heart failure (10 people) and obesity (50) trials missed; one brain-blood-flow signal. Verdict: Mostly negative. Safety: Short trials up to 4 months report it was well tolerated; no long-term data. Verdict: Short-term only.
